- **Naperville Gymnastics Parent & Tot:** The page links to "See Schedule & Register", but the schedule and price weren't in the text I read.
- **The Little Gym of Naperville:** The page says the classes run from 4 months up to preschool age. Its classes page says a parent must take part for children under 3. No winter days, times or prices were shown.
- **Preschool Open Gym:** This is a drop-in session, not a class. The page says to check the event calendar for changes or cancellations, so confirm the hours before going.

I left out the Naperville Park District's Gym Kittens (ages 1–2 with a parent) and Gym Cubs (age 2 with a parent) classes. The only schedules I found for them were from 2023. The Park District's winter 2027 program guide is due out December 2, 2026, so they may reappear then.
